name: flint-button
title: FlintButton
description: cta: Button that strikes like flint: a steel rakes the stone and throws sparks; heat builds until it catches (canvas 2D, native button, reduced motion -> plain)

item.name: flint-button
item.summary: cta: Button that strikes like flint: a steel rakes the stone and throws sparks; heat builds until it catches (canvas 2D, native button, reduced motion -> plain)

useWhen: One primary action with a moment of character (start, ignite, launch, generate)
Brand pages about fire, energy or making
avoidWhen: Forms with several buttons in a row
Light pages where a dark stone button would look out of place

alternatives.name: magnetic-button
alternatives.when: When the button should feel physical without fire

tiers.0: The control alone (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: A plain stone button: no steel, no sparks, no glow, no canvas. Clicks work as usual.

input.pointer: Click strikes; rubbing fast across the button heats it
input.keyboard: A native <button>: Enter and Space strike, focus ring visible

a11y.notes: A native <button> with its text label (which becomes litLabel while it burns). The optional heat status under it is aria-live=polite. The spark canvas and the steel are aria-hidden. Sparks last under 3 s per strike.

props.name: children
props.effect: Required. The button's label while cold.

props.name: litLabel
props.effect: The label while the stone burns.

props.name: statusText
props.type: { cold: string; warm: string; hot: string; burning: string } | null
props.effect: Visible heat status under the button (aria-live polite); null hides it.

props.name: onClick
props.effect: Your action; runs on every strike.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

props.name: ref
props.effect: Receives the <button>; className, style and the rest of the props go on the button too.

mistakes: The sparks fly above the button (about 200 px): leave room and do not clip the parent with overflow: hidden.
One per view: it is a primary action, not a toolbar button.
ref, className and style apply to the <button>, not to the wrapper.
verify: Server HTML has a native <button> with its label.
Enter strikes: the steel sweeps, sparks fly and the status warms.
After the sparks fade and the stone cools, the loop stops.
